operators.name: line
operators.limits: Finite points; t in [0,1].
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: polyline
operators.limits: At least 2 points; t is normalized segment index, not arc length.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: circle_arc
operators.limits: Caller supplies orthonormal plane axes and positive radius; angles in radians.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: ellipse
operators.limits: Caller supplies orthonormal plane axes and positive radii; angles in radians.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: bezier_curve
operators.limits: Degree 1..5; t in [0,1]; finite control points.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: nurbs_curve
operators.limits: Degree 1..5; poles <=32; ordinary XYZ plus positive weight; valid full knot vector required. Returns p,d,dd.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: catmull_rom
operators.limits: One uniform Catmull-Rom segment between p1 and p2; not centripetal parameterization.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: curve_trim
operators.limits: Parameter interval mapping for an existing curve; caller checks interval is in the curve domain.
operators.test_scope: degree<=5, poles<=32 for NURBS; polyline parameter is by segment index

operators.name: plane
operators.limits: Finite independent nonzero direction vectors; rectangular domain [0,1]^2.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: bezier_patch
operators.limits: Nonrational tensor patch, 2..6 poles per direction, row-major U then V.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: nurbs_patch
operators.limits: 2..32 poles per axis, degree 1..5 below pole count; finite positive weights and monotonic full knots; caller ensures legal multiplicities.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: ruled_surface
operators.limits: Two compatible nonrational B-spline curves sharing degree, knots and pole count <=32.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: extrude_surface
operators.limits: Rational profile <=32 poles, degree 1..5; nonzero finite extrusion; valid profile required.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: revolve_surface
operators.limits: Exact rational rotation about Y; profile (radius,axial_y,0,weight); nonzero span <=2pi split into <=4 arcs. U is rational arc parameter, not linear angle.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: sweep_surface
operators.limits: GPU exact translation surface A(u)+B(v), <=32 poles/axis; general path sweep uses CPU CAD kernel. No arbitrary GPU moving-frame sweep claim.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: loft_surface
operators.limits: GPU natural cubic interpolation through 2..11 uniformly spaced, compatible nonrational sections; <=32 poles/section. General wires use CPU CAD kernel.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: coons_fill
operators.limits: Four cubic nonrational Bezier boundaries with matching corners; exact bicubic Coons construction.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: offset_surface
operators.limits: One-level offset of a regular NURBS surface, sampled by its normal; current arena holds 14 objects. STEP retains native offset definition; no global self-intersection guarantee.
operators.test_scope: sweep: exact translation on GPU, native path sweep on CPU; loft: compatible sections on GPU; offset is an offset definition, not a fitted net

operators.name: fill_nside
operators.limits: CPU variational CAD filling; C0/G1/G2 constraints need appropriate support faces. Batch verifies a warped five-edge C0 boundary.
operators.test_scope: native boundary constraints C0/G1/G2; five-edge C0 composition is the batch fixture

operators.name: blend_g1
operators.limits: Cubic strip matching compatible rail positions and cross derivatives; derivatives supplied by caller, no automatic global shape optimization.
operators.test_scope: cubic strip with prescribed rail positions and cross derivatives

operators.name: blend_g2
operators.limits: Quintic strip matching compatible rail positions and first/second cross derivatives; degree V <=5, poles V <=32.
operators.test_scope: quintic strip with prescribed rail positions, first/second cross derivatives

operators.name: continuity_check
operators.limits: Regular coincident seam samples. Returns gap, unsigned tangent-plane angle and curvature mismatch in 3 tangent directions; sample evidence is not global Class-A certification.
operators.test_scope: sampled geometry, not a global proof of Class-A quality

operators.name: curvature
operators.limits: Returns Gaussian K, signed mean H and surface Jacobian. Zero Jacobian flags a singular/degenerate point where K/H are not valid.
operators.test_scope: regular surface points; singular points require explicit handling

operators.name: project_curve
operators.limits: CPU normal projection of a native CAD curve; failure raises ValueError.
operators.test_scope: B-rep topology executes explicitly on CPU, after GPU batch readback

operators.name: intersect_surfaces
operators.limits: CPU intersection of native untrimmed surfaces; returns native 3D curves; not a full solid Boolean operation.
operators.test_scope: B-rep topology executes explicitly on CPU, after GPU batch readback

operators.name: trim_surface
operators.limits: CPU B-rep construction from simple closed UV polygon loops; straight UV edges, optional holes; caller provides noncrossing loops within the parameter domain.
operators.test_scope: B-rep topology executes explicitly on CPU, after GPU batch readback

operators.name: split_surface
operators.limits: CPU native CAD splitter with caller-supplied tool shapes; result must be a valid B-rep.
operators.test_scope: B-rep topology executes explicitly on CPU, after GPU batch readback

operators.name: join_curves
operators.limits: CPU composite B-spline conversion; ordered, connected compatible native curves; rejects disconnected input.
operators.test_scope: B-rep topology executes explicitly on CPU, after GPU batch readback

operators.name: sew
operators.limits: CPU face sewing; solid=True requires one closed shell, followed by orientation/validity check; does not union overlapping solids.
operators.test_scope: B-rep topology executes explicitly on CPU, after GPU batch readback

operators.name: box
operators.limits: Axis-aligned finite strict min/max; 8 vertices, 12 triangles.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: uv_sphere
operators.limits: Positive radius; segments>=3, rings>=2; count must fit 4096 vertices/4096 triangles.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: cylinder
operators.limits: Z-aligned closed faceted cylinder; positive radius/height; segments>=3.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: cone
operators.limits: Z-aligned closed cone with one apex; positive bottom radius/height; segments>=3. Same function also supports truncated cones.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: torus
operators.limits: Z-axis ring torus; major>minor>0; both segment counts>=3; bounded mesh capacity.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: grid
operators.limits: Independent plane vectors; steps>=1; optional sin(pi*u)sin(pi*v) displacement along the plane normal; open mesh.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: triangulate_polygon
operators.limits: Ear clipping of one planar simple convex/concave polygon, 3..64 distinct vertices, no holes or collinear overlaps; absolute geometric tolerances.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: extrude_face
operators.limits: Fresh destination; one planar simple polygon <=64 corners; positive extrusion dot polygon normal; creates caps and walls.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: inset_face
operators.limits: Fresh destination; strictly convex planar polygon <=64; fraction in (0,1); shrinks toward vertex centroid, not constant-distance edge offset.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: subdivide
operators.limits: Fresh separate destination; linear 1-to-4 triangle subdivision and shared-midpoint welding; preserves shape, not Catmull-Clark smoothing.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: weld
operators.limits: Positive finite tolerance; first representative within radius; O(n^2); does not remove degenerate faces created by a large tolerance.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: normals
operators.limits: Area-weighted vertex normals; valid oriented indexed triangles required; sharp edges require split vertices.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: bevel_vertices
operators.limits: Vertex truncation of a closed convex tri-valent polyhedron: <=64 vertices, <=96 edges, convex faces <=16 corners; fraction in (0,0.5). Unsupported valence rejected; not general edge filleting.
operators.test_scope: ear clipping: planar simple polygon <=64 corners; inset is fractional; bevel: convex tri-valent polyhedron; welding uses representative tolerance

operators.name: translate
operators.limits: Finite coordinates. Apply to control points or mesh vertices; vectors/derivatives omit translation.
operators.test_scope: rotation/mirror accept arbitrary axes/planes; zero normal is outside the valid input domain

operators.name: rotate
operators.limits: Finite nonzero arbitrary axis; radians; Rodrigues rotation.
operators.test_scope: rotation/mirror accept arbitrary axes/planes; zero normal is outside the valid input domain

operators.name: scale
operators.limits: Finite component scales; negative scales reflect orientation; caller updates face winding and normals for whole meshes.
operators.test_scope: rotation/mirror accept arbitrary axes/planes; zero normal is outside the valid input domain

operators.name: mirror
operators.limits: Finite nonzero arbitrary plane normal; caller updates face winding and normals for whole meshes.
operators.test_scope: rotation/mirror accept arbitrary axes/planes; zero normal is outside the valid input domain

operators.name: hermite_curve
operators.limits: Cubic curve with finite endpoint positions and parameter derivatives; ordinary XYZW control points.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: parabola_curve
operators.limits: Positive focal distance; local coordinates (t^2/(4*focal),t); caller supplies orthonormal axes and finite bounded domain.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: hyperbola_curve
operators.limits: Positive semi-axes; one hyperbola branch (a*cosh(t),b*sinh(t)); bounded parameters must avoid floating-point overflow.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: helix_curve
operators.limits: Circular helix; pitch is axial distance per full turn; finite bounded angle domain; STEP uses a separately error-checked spline approximation.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: spiral_curve
operators.limits: Planar Archimedean spiral r=r0+slope*t; strictly positive radius over the domain; STEP spline approximation has measured error.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: three_point_arc
operators.limits: Three distinct noncollinear 3D points; arc passes through the middle point; absolute degeneracy threshold 1e-20 on squared cross product.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: interpolate_curve
operators.limits: Natural cubic interpolation through 2..11 finite points, uniform parameters; <=31 poles; not chord-length or periodic interpolation.
operators.backend: CUDA construction/evaluation + independent CAD or analytic reference

operators.name: curve_reverse
operators.limits: Reverses parameter domain and first derivative; second derivative is preserved; base kinds 0..6.

operators.name: curve_length
operators.limits: Composite five-point Gaussian quadrature of speed; positive panel count and regular finite base curve required; numerical estimate, not certified adaptive integration.

operators.name: resample_curve
operators.limits: Numerical arc-length inversion by bisection, fraction in [0,1]; regular nonzero-length base curve; fixed integration work bounds accuracy.

operators.name: closest_point_curve
operators.limits: 128-interval coarse basin selection plus golden-section refinement and endpoint checks; approximate nearest point, not a global proof for arbitrary oscillatory/self-crossing curves.

operators.name: planar_offset_curve
operators.limits: Regular planar curve with nonzero plane normal; left offset normal=cross(normal,tangent); returns a point, not offset derivatives; no self-intersection cleanup.
operators.backend: CUDA point offset + native CAD offset

operators.name: solid_sphere
operators.limits: Positive radius; GPU definition/mesh and exact analytic CPU B-rep topology; orthonormal right-handed frame.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_ellipsoid
operators.limits: Three positive radii; affine-transformed exact spherical B-rep represented as rational surfaces; GPU faceted preview is separate.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_cylinder
operators.limits: Positive radius/height; closed analytic side and planar caps; local axis Z=cross(X,Y).
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_cone
operators.limits: Positive base radius/height, one apex; closed exact conical B-rep.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_frustum
operators.limits: Positive radii/height; fixture uses unequal radii; equal radii should use cylinder rather than OCCT cone builder.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_torus
operators.limits: Ring torus major>minor>0; exact native toroidal B-rep, separate GPU preview mesh.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_capsule
operators.limits: Positive radius/cylinder height; hemispherical ends, exact revolved CAD profile and bounded GPU latitude mesh.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_prism
operators.limits: Regular polygon prism, integer sides 3..64; positive circumradius/height; exact planar CAD faces.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_pyramid
operators.limits: Regular polygon base with centered apex, sides 3..64; exact planar CAD faces; not a general arbitrary-base pyramid.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: solid_wedge
operators.limits: Positive sizes and 0<top_width<width; one sloped side, rectangular bottom/top and trapezoidal end faces.
operators.backend: CUDA definition/mesh + native CPU CAD solid

operators.name: bend
operators.limits: Local X bends into XZ about Y; radius>0 and radius+Z>0; caller constrains angle to avoid overlaps. STEP mesh fixture is faceted, not an exact deformed NURBS claim.

operators.name: twist
operators.limits: Rotation about local Z by rate*Z; geometry may self-intersect for excessive deformation. Mesh STEP is faceted.

operators.name: taper
operators.limits: Local XY scale=1+rate*Z; strictly positive scale required; mesh STEP is faceted.

operators.name: sweep_path
operators.limits: 2..32 stations; convex origin-containing CCW profile with 3..31 corners; discrete parallel transport, no antiparallel tangents. Exact piecewise bilinear GPU net exported to CAD; not a certified continuous RMF solver.
operators.backend: CUDA discrete parallel transport and control net + CPU caps/sew

operators.name: loft_chordal
operators.limits: 2..11 compatible nonrational sections; centroid chord parameters, natural cubic C2 interpolation. Coincident adjacent centroids rejected.
operators.backend: CUDA nonuniform natural cubic solve + independent dense solve

operators.name: catmull_clark
operators.limits: One step on closed consistently oriented manifold quads, <=128 vertices/faces, <=256 edges; fresh destination; boundary/crease rules are separate operations.

operators.name: loop_subdivide
operators.limits: One original Loop step, closed consistently oriented manifold triangles; <=128 vertices, <=256 triangles, <=384 edges; fresh destination.

operators.name: resample_grid
operators.limits: Bilinear sampling of a 2..32 by 2..32 source grid; output within bounded mesh capacity; preserves bilinear geometry, no curvature reconstruction.

operators.name: resample_polyline
operators.limits: Uniform accumulated chord distance, 2..128 finite input points, 2..4096 outputs; zero-length adjacent segments rejected.

operators.name: boolean_union
operators.limits: CPU OCCT fuse of valid native B-reps; no GPU Boolean claim; failures raise.

operators.name: boolean_cut
operators.limits: CPU native A minus B; input topology must be valid; the result may legitimately be empty.

operators.name: boolean_common
operators.limits: CPU native intersection, including valid empty intersection; distinct from untrimmed surface intersection.

operators.name: delete_faces
operators.limits: GPU triangle-mask deletion compacts triangles but leaves vertex storage; CAD deletion takes an open/closed shell, not a solid that would become invalid. Does not automatically cap holes.
operators.backend: CUDA triangle mask + native CAD shell-face deletion

operators.name: fill_hole
operators.limits: Single simple planar boundary, <=64 mesh vertices; loop opposes remaining halfedges; 1e-12 weld tolerance. Native planar cap can then be sewn. Curved filling uses the separate fill_nside primitive.
operators.backend: CUDA oriented boundary filling + native planar cap/sew

operators.name: revolve_profile
operators.limits: GPU full 2pi revolution of a simple CCW closed positive-radius RZ profile, <=32 corners. Native CAD supports a planar closed face and arbitrary axis/angle; mesh is a separate faceted preview.
operators.backend: CUDA profile revolution + exact native CAD revolve

operators.name: smooth_laplacian
operators.limits: Uniform adjacency Laplacian, <=512 vertices/1024 triangles, 1..64 iterations, 0<lambda<1; boundaries move and volume can shrink.
operators.backend: CUDA uniform adjacency smoothing + dense matrix reference

operators.name: smooth_taubin
operators.limits: Alternating lambda/mu uniform Laplacian, -1<mu<0; bounded mesh as above. Reduces shrinkage in the fixture but does not guarantee exact volume preservation.
operators.backend: CUDA two-pass smoothing + dense matrix reference

operators.name: knot_insert
operators.limits: Exact interior B-spline insertion; nonperiodic tested.

operators.name: knot_remove
operators.limits: Native removal with a requested tolerance; can reject removal.

operators.name: degree_elevate
operators.limits: Exact B-spline degree elevation to <=25.

operators.name: degree_reduce
operators.limits: Single nonrational Bezier span; constrained LS and 2048 off-grid checks, sampled error only.

operators.name: curve_split
operators.limits: Exact two-way split strictly inside the domain.

operators.name: curve_reparameterize
operators.limits: Affine increasing finite domain map.

operators.name: fit_curve
operators.limits: Nonperiodic cubic least squares, chord parameters, fixed endpoints.

operators.name: fair_curve
operators.limits: Penalized second control-pole differences; fixed endpoints, no interpolation promise.

operators.name: sweep_guided
operators.limits: CUDA projected guide rail defines profile frame; nonzero projected rail required.
operators.backend: CUDA frame/profile construction + CPU native B-spline sheet

operators.name: sweep_scaled
operators.limits: CUDA positive scalar per path station; <=32 stations and <=31 corners.
operators.backend: CUDA frame/profile construction + CPU native B-spline sheet

operators.name: sweep_variable
operators.limits: CUDA compatible polygon profile per station; bilinear side sheet, no self-intersection guarantee.
operators.backend: CUDA frame/profile construction + CPU native B-spline sheet

operators.name: sweep_closed
operators.limits: CUDA RMF holonomy distributed by chord length; duplicate endpoint/profile/scale; G0 closed seam, no continuous G1 guarantee.
operators.backend: CUDA frame/profile construction + CPU native B-spline sheet

operators.name: loft_compatible
operators.limits: Exact degree/knot/domain harmonization then native loft; caller supplies matching orientation/correspondence.
operators.backend: CPU exact B-spline compatibility + native loft

operators.name: surface_extend
operators.limits: Exact polynomial U extrapolation of a nonrational Bezier patch with original [0,1] domain.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: surface_untrim
operators.limits: Rebuild the natural support-domain face; does not restore discarded upstream geometry.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: surface_replace
operators.limits: Isolated untrimmed rectangular patch, matching sampled boundary; arbitrary solid-face replacement excluded.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: match_g1
operators.limits: Compatible bicubic Bezier U border, same V orientation; positive derivative scale. Unit scale tested C1.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: match_g2
operators.limits: Same compatible border; position/D1/D2 rows matched. Unit scale tested C2.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: fair_patches
operators.limits: Joint 7x4 composite net; <=64 projected bending-gradient steps, C2-compatible locked outer boundary and orthogonal seam projection.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: surface_quality
operators.limits: Sampled Jacobian/principal curvature diagnostics; not global regularity/Class-A certification.
operators.backend: CUDA control net / CPU OCCT surface and independent NumPy reference

operators.name: fillet
operators.limits: Native selected-edge constant positive radius; infeasible blends reject.

operators.name: variable_fillet
operators.limits: Native linear R1/R2 law along selected contour; positive feasible radii.

evidence.note: Rolling sphere envelope with varying radius; constant-radius prism integration is not the variable-fillet volume formula.

operators.name: chamfer
operators.limits: Native symmetric selected-edge chamfer.

operators.name: thicken
operators.limits: Native simple face/shell offset and side walls; no general offset self-intersection solver.

operators.name: shell
operators.limits: Native remove-selected-face and join offset; feasible test box, negative inward thickness.

operators.name: draft
operators.limits: Native planar/cylindrical/conical face draft, abs(angle)<45deg, explicit neutral plane.

operators.name: rib
operators.limits: Thicken an explicit planar rib profile and Boolean-fuse with base; not automatic skeleton ribs.

operators.name: decimate
operators.limits: CPU shortest-edge collapse; closed oriented manifold, link/no-flip tests and vertex-displacement budget; not a Hausdorff guarantee.

operators.name: adaptive_remesh
operators.limits: CPU conforming length-driven midpoint refinement; piecewise planar geometry preserved; <=16 passes.

operators.name: edge_flip
operators.limits: CPU two-triangle planar convex interior edge; reject duplicate diagonal.

operators.name: bridge_loops
operators.limits: CPU disjoint equally sized oriented boundary loops with caller correspondence; may return open surface.

operators.name: region_extrude
operators.limits: CPU selected triangle region translated outward with boundary walls; vector must point out of every selected face.

operators.name: crease_subdivide
operators.limits: CPU one Loop step with hard edge/boundary rules and >=3-crease corner lock.

operators.name: self_intersection_detect
operators.limits: CPU nonadjacent triangle crossing pairs; O(T^2), coplanar overlapping candidate rejects as unsupported.
operators.backend: CPU explicit mesh repair / native shape healing

operators.name: self_intersection_repair
operators.limits: CPU explicit face-discard policy covering detected crossings; reports open result, no automatic closed reconstruction.
operators.backend: CPU explicit mesh repair / native shape healing

operators.name: nonmanifold_repair
operators.limits: CPU vertex-fan splitting, same face geometry, explicit new boundaries.
operators.backend: CPU explicit mesh repair / native shape healing

operators.name: tolerance_unify
operators.limits: Copied native shape tolerances 1e-9..1e-3 mm; does not heal larger geometric gaps.
operators.backend: CPU explicit mesh repair / native shape healing

operators.name: small_feature_cleanup
operators.limits: Native same-domain unification and small-edge/wireframe repair; coplanar sliver test. Arbitrary curved sliver removal not guaranteed.
operators.backend: CPU explicit mesh repair / native shape healing

operators.name: stable_handles
operators.limits: Typed feature ids stable through parameter/history/save-load; never reused in live graph.

operators.name: select_subshape
operators.limits: Unique geometric centroid point/edge/face query; revision-stale or ambiguous selections reject.

operators.name: feature_dag
operators.limits: Typed DAG, cycle rejection, descendant-only invalidation and memoized execution.

operators.name: history_undo
operators.limits: Undo graph edit, clear caches, invalidate all prior subshape selections.

operators.name: history_redo
operators.limits: Redo graph edit; branching edit clears redo.

operators.name: feature_rebuild
operators.limits: Deterministic registered operations and JSON graph; same geometry checked after fresh load/rebuild.

operators.name: snap_point
operators.limits: CUDA grid and <=4096 nearest vertices; CPU native CAD nearest point on edge/trimmed face. Capture radius can reject. Native ties return first solution.

operators.name: merge_mesh
operators.limits: CPU concatenate indexed objects; optional first-representative weld. Internal faces remain; solid union uses boolean_union, surface merge uses sew_surfaces.

operators.name: move_along_curve
operators.limits: CUDA bounded analytic/B-spline curve records; numerical Gauss arc length and inverse solve; open-domain clamp or reject, unit tangent frame. No periodic wrapping.
operators.backend: CUDA arc-length positioning + CPU instance transform

operators.name: move_on_mesh
operators.limits: CUDA straightest face walk with edge parallel transport; <=128 vertices,256 triangles/crossings. Ambiguous vertex hits, nonmanifold crossings and degenerate faces reject; open boundary clamps with status=2.
operators.backend: CUDA intrinsic triangle walk + CPU instance transform

operators.name: move_on_surface
operators.limits: CUDA NURBS UV displacement returns attached point, path tangent and normal; finite domain, regular surface and nonzero displacement. UV trajectory is not a world-space geodesic.
operators.backend: CUDA UV placement/frame + CPU instance transform
